title: Writes Within a Set
statement: Given a set $S$ of integer addresses, an instruction writes in $S$ if it is a constant assignment, arithmetic operation, or load whose destination register belongs to $S$. A store is not considered to write in $S$, while every other instruction is considered to write in $S$.
